1hbo4mo.q: Anyone who is civilly obliged to compensate damage caused by a road accident is released from the obligation if they compensate the injured party.
1hbo4mo.why: The civil obligation ends once the injured party has been fully compensated.

xmyr78.q: Anyone who is civilly obliged to compensate damage caused by a road accident may agree with the injured party on the amount of compensation.
xmyr78.why: Compensation is a private matter, so the parties can agree on the amount, often through the insurer.

1ydc889.q: Anyone who is civilly obliged to compensate damage caused by a road accident may have their own car repaired.
1ydc889.why: The person liable remains free to repair their own vehicle; civil liability does not prevent this.

1tdb03v.q: Anyone who is civilly obliged to compensate damage caused by a road accident may be assisted by a road accident claims consultant.
1tdb03v.why: The person who must pay compensation may use a road accident claims consultant (consulente d'infortunistica) to handle the case.

1f57ydz.q: Anyone who is civilly obliged to compensate damage caused by a road accident may, as an alternative, ask for their driving licence to be revoked.
1f57ydz.why: Licence revocation (revoca) is an administrative penalty imposed by the authority. It cannot be chosen instead of compensation.

1qvfvk7.q: Anyone who is civilly obliged to compensate damage caused by a road accident is released from all criminal liability by paying the amount of the damage.
1qvfvk7.why: Criminal liability is separate from civil liability, so paying for the damage does not erase any offence committed.

6akpc7.q: Anyone who is both criminally and civilly liable for a road accident is subject to the penalties set by the Criminal Code.
6akpc7.why: A person criminally liable for an accident faces Criminal Code penalties, for example for negligent injury or homicide.

144fngc.q: Anyone who is both criminally and civilly liable for a road accident is required to compensate the damage.
144fngc.why: Civil liability requires the person to compensate damage caused to people and property.

pbrv6y.q: Anyone who is both criminally and civilly liable for a road accident who has violated Highway Code rules is also subject to the related penalties.
pbrv6y.why: Criminal, civil and administrative liability add up, so Highway Code violations also bring their own penalties.

g10t7w.q: Anyone who is both criminally and civilly liable for a road accident may have their driving licence suspended.
g10t7w.why: For serious road offences the licence can be suspended (sospensione), including as an additional penalty.

1od7n04.q: Anyone who is both criminally and civilly liable for a road accident may have their driving licence revoked.
1od7n04.why: In serious cases, such as aggravated road homicide, the driver can lose the licence through revocation (revoca).

1381ghq.q: Anyone who is both criminally and civilly liable for a road accident may be subject to a review of their driving licence.
1381ghq.why: After an accident the authority may order a licence review (revisione) to check the driver still meets the requirements.

enmcca.q: Anyone who is both criminally and civilly liable for a road accident is always subject to preventive arrest.
enmcca.why: Arrest is not automatic; it depends on the seriousness of the offence and the circumstances.

1blgd2z.q: Anyone who is both criminally and civilly liable for a road accident cannot continue to drive vehicles of the same category, only a lower category.
1blgd2z.why: No such rule exists. Liability does not restrict a driver to lower categories unless the licence is suspended or revoked.

1neck9q.q: Anyone who is both criminally and civilly liable for a road accident is in every case subject to licence revocation.
1neck9q.why: Revocation applies only in cases set by law, for particularly serious offences, not in every case.

9ryqt2.q: Anyone who is both criminally and civilly liable for a road accident is not subject to Highway Code penalties.
9ryqt2.why: Highway Code administrative penalties apply in addition to criminal and civil liability.

1vc4mm.q: Criminal liability connected with a road accident is excluded when there is only unintentional damage to property.
1vc4mm.why: Unintentional damage to property alone is not a crime, so only civil liability remains.

xo8nqf.q: Criminal liability connected with a road accident is excluded when the act is not considered a crime.
xo8nqf.why: If the act is not defined by law as a crime, there is no criminal liability.

7uswq5.q: Criminal liability connected with a road accident is excluded when the event is due to force majeure.
7uswq5.why: Force majeure (an unforeseeable, unavoidable event) removes fault and so criminal liability.

1sp3nwh.q: Criminal liability connected with a road accident is excluded when assistance has been given to the victim.
1sp3nwh.why: Giving aid is a duty and does not erase an offence already committed.

1vh8q0f.q: Criminal liability connected with a road accident is excluded whenever the damage has been compensated.
1vh8q0f.why: Paying compensation does not by itself extinguish the crime, as criminal and civil liability are independent.

1rivio7.q: Criminal liability connected with a road accident is excluded if the insurance company intervenes and adequately compensates the injured party.
1rivio7.why: The insurer's payment covers civil damage but does not remove the driver's personal criminal liability.

91mipn.q: Criminal liability connected with a road accident arises if it causes serious injury to people.
91mipn.why: Serious injury to people is a crime and gives rise to criminal liability.

6upbqo.q: Criminal liability connected with a road accident also arises in the case of negligent homicide.
6upbqo.why: Negligent homicide, including road homicide (omicidio stradale), is a crime that carries criminal liability.

1r9ohu7.q: Criminal liability connected with a road accident arises when provisions of the Criminal Code are violated.
1r9ohu7.why: Criminal liability arises from breaking criminal law, such as negligent injury or homicide.

1lp3zjb.q: Criminal liability connected with a road accident arises in every case in which the Highway Code is violated.
1lp3zjb.why: Many Highway Code violations are only administrative offences, not crimes.

xos3p3.q: Criminal liability connected with a road accident arises when the vehicle is completely destroyed.
xos3p3.why: Destruction of the vehicle is property damage and is not by itself a crime.

lbiexv.q: Criminal liability connected with a road accident arises in all cases of damage to people or property.
lbiexv.why: Unintentional property damage is not a crime, so liability does not arise in every case of damage.

69zuzu.q: Criminal liability connected with a road accident arises for the vehicle owner if the driver has not been identified.
69zuzu.why: Criminal liability is personal; it falls on the driver, not on the owner just because the driver is unknown.

1uckx9l.q: Civil liability connected with a road accident consists of the obligation to compensate damage caused to both people and property.
1uckx9l.why: Civil liability means compensating damage to both people and property.

xsbwla.q: Civil liability connected with a road accident falls on the owner and the driver of the vehicle.
xsbwla.why: Both the driver and the vehicle owner are jointly liable for civil damages.

17v6pz6.q: Civil liability connected with a road accident obliges the person responsible to compensate the damage.
17v6pz6.why: Whoever causes unjust damage must compensate for it.

bkz3o8.q: Civil liability connected with a road accident is independent of criminal liability and administrative liability.
bkz3o8.why: The three types of liability (civil, criminal, administrative) are separate and can apply together.

gqsbn5.q: Civil liability connected with a road accident is based on the principle that any damage caused must be compensated.
gqsbn5.why: The underlying principle is that any unjust damage caused must be compensated.

oy0uu1.q: Civil liability connected with a road accident is excluded in the event of the injured party's death.
oy0uu1.why: Death does not remove liability; compensation is owed to the entitled family members.

1yn4fms.q: Civil liability connected with a road accident is limited to compensating damage to property only.
1yn4fms.why: Compensation covers damage to property and also injury to people.

ltjrl.q: Civil liability connected with a road accident is excluded for minor damage.
ltjrl.why: Even minor damage must be compensated; there is no threshold that removes liability.

17zkuyd.q: Civil liability connected with a road accident is aggravated by the lack of insurance cover.
17zkuyd.why: Lack of insurance brings penalties, but the civil liability itself is not made greater.

dm2f35.q: Civil liability connected with a road accident falls on the insurance company even for damage exceeding the policy limits.
dm2f35.why: The insurer pays only up to the policy limit (massimale); any excess is paid by the person liable.

ltlnzr.q: Compulsory RCA insurance covers damage suffered by transported third parties if the vehicle is authorised to carry people.
ltlnzr.why: Compulsory RCA covers damage to passengers (terzi trasportati) in vehicles authorised to carry people.

a67zfy.q: Direct compensation in road accidents applies if there is damage to the vehicle and minor injuries to the driver.
a67zfy.why: Direct compensation (risarcimento diretto) covers vehicle damage and minor injuries to the driver, within legal limits.

1lmcf1w.q: The direct compensation procedure does not apply if more than two vehicles are involved.
1lmcf1w.why: Direct compensation applies only to collisions between two identified, insured vehicles.

jf5525.q: Direct compensation is excluded if a motorcycle is involved in the accident.
jf5525.why: Motorcycles are covered by direct compensation like cars, provided the other conditions are met.

1c22ywj.q: In an accident with vehicle damage, the direct compensation claim must necessarily be accompanied by photographs.
1c22ywj.why: Photographs are useful evidence but are not mandatory for the claim.

17fvt2q.q: Compulsory insurance covers damage suffered only by third parties transported in taxis.
17fvt2q.why: Compulsory insurance covers passengers in any vehicle authorised to carry people, not only taxis.

1yc2k9h.q: Liability for damage connected with the circulation of vehicles lies with the driver and the owner of the vehicle, in the case of civil liability.
1yc2k9h.why: For civil liability, the driver and the owner are jointly responsible.

gh72ow.q: Liability for damage connected with the circulation of vehicles lies with the driver of the vehicle, in the case of criminal liability.
gh72ow.why: Criminal liability is personal and falls on the driver.

d5e80e.q: Liability for damage connected with the circulation of vehicles does not lie with the vehicle owner if they prove the circulation took place against their will.
d5e80e.why: The owner is freed from civil liability if they prove the vehicle was used against their will, for example when stolen.

1ue6lcq.q: Liability for damage connected with the circulation of vehicles lies with the vehicle owner, in the case of criminal liability.
1ue6lcq.why: Criminal liability is personal: it belongs to the driver, not the owner.

1df8z0.q: Liability for damage connected with the circulation of vehicles lies only with the driver if there has been damage to property.
1df8z0.why: For property damage, both the driver and the owner are jointly liable under civil law.

1nb9zmc.q: When the compulsory third-party car insurance (RCA) has expired, you may incur confiscation of the vehicle.
1nb9zmc.why: Driving without insurance brings a fine and seizure, and confiscation (confisca) of the vehicle if the situation is not regularised.

1b2mo2i.q: When the compulsory third-party car insurance (RCA) has expired, you may keep using the vehicle only for short trips.
1b2mo2i.why: Without valid insurance driving is prohibited, even for short trips.

i9owm5.q: When the compulsory third-party car insurance (RCA) has expired, you may use the vehicle only within Italian territory.
i9owm5.why: Without valid insurance you cannot drive anywhere, in Italy or abroad.

kzzugp.q: When the compulsory third-party car insurance (RCA) has expired, it is possible to leave the vehicle parked on public roads.
kzzugp.why: A vehicle parked on a public road must also have valid insurance.

j4o04o.q: When the compulsory third-party car insurance (RCA) has expired, the vehicle must undergo a technical inspection before being put back into circulation.
j4o04o.why: Renewing the insurance is enough; a technical inspection (collaudo) is not required because a policy expired.

pjia5d.q: When the compulsory third-party car insurance (RCA) has expired, you may keep using the vehicle only if you are willing to personally pay for any damage caused.
pjia5d.why: Insurance is compulsory and cannot be replaced by a promise to pay personally.

f0ukdz.q: The "road accident victims guarantee fund" provides compensation for damage to people caused by uninsured vehicles.
f0ukdz.why: The guarantee fund (fondo di garanzia) compensates injury to people caused by uninsured vehicles.

16kol65.q: The "road accident victims guarantee fund" provides compensation for damage to people caused by unidentified vehicles.
16kol65.why: The fund also steps in when the responsible vehicle is not identified, for example in a hit-and-run.

ofnvh3.q: The "road accident victims guarantee fund" guarantees a lifetime annuity to the injured driver.
ofnvh3.why: The fund compensates damage suffered; it does not provide lifetime annuities.

1u5ls80.q: The "road accident victims guarantee fund" is a reward for those who have not caused accidents.
1u5ls80.why: The fund exists to compensate victims in special cases; it is not a bonus for accident-free drivers.

ju8f7o.q: The "road accident victims guarantee fund" is an optional agreement.
ju8f7o.why: The fund is established by law and financed by compulsory contributions on RCA policies; it is not optional.

1dsgpkr.q: The "road accident victims guarantee fund" compensates damage caused by underage drivers.
1dsgpkr.why: The fund does not depend on the driver's age; it covers uninsured or unidentified vehicles.

ohqjs5.q: The insurance policies usually taken out to cover theft, fire, vandalism, natural events or damage to one's own vehicle (kasko policy) are not compulsory.
ohqjs5.why: Only RCA is compulsory; theft, fire, vandalism and kasko cover are optional.

1r0qrlp.q: In an insurance policy against the risk of theft or fire, the compensation due cannot exceed the value the vehicle had when it was stolen or caught fire.
1r0qrlp.why: The payout cannot exceed the vehicle's value at the time of the theft or fire.

1x16giq.q: If the vehicle is stolen in a foreign country, to activate the insurance the report must be repeated in Italy.
1x16giq.why: For a theft abroad, the report (denuncia) must also be filed with the Italian authorities to activate the policy.

skibej.q: The insurance policy against the risk of theft or fire guarantees a lifetime annuity to the vehicle owner if it is stolen or catches fire.
skibej.why: The policy pays an indemnity up to the vehicle's value, not a lifetime annuity.

1ci5rdz.q: To take out an insurance policy against the risk of fire, the vehicle must be fitted with an automatic battery cut-off device.
1ci5rdz.why: The law does not require an automatic battery cut-off to take out fire insurance.

exxaig.q: To take out an insurance policy against the risk of theft, the vehicle must be fitted with an anti-theft device.
exxaig.why: An anti-theft device is not a legal requirement for the policy; the insurer may only take it into account in the premium.

18b286.q: Insurance policies against vehicle fire normally cover only damage caused by arson (intentional fires) and not that caused by accidental fires.
18b286.why: Fire policies normally cover accidental fires as well as intentional ones.

sjfds1.q: The limits (massimali) of the RCA (compulsory third-party car insurance) policy are the maximum amounts the insurance company undertakes to pay in the event of an accident.
sjfds1.why: The massimali are the maximum amounts the insurer will pay for each accident.

1e1f2fe.q: The minimum amount of the limits (massimali) of the RCA policy is set by law.
1e1f2fe.why: The law sets the compulsory minimum limits (massimali) of an RCA policy.

cbz7xw.q: The limits (massimali) of the RCA policy can be increased, at the customer's choice, by paying a higher sum (insurance premium).
cbz7xw.why: The customer can choose higher limits by paying a higher premium (premio).

en57i.q: The limits (massimali) of the RCA policy are the sums of money the insurance company collects each year from its customer.
en57i.why: The massimali are the insurer's payment ceiling; the amount paid by the customer is called the premium (premio).

1eb5g97.q: The R.C.A. (compulsory motor third-party liability) policy ceilings (massimali) increase every year.
1eb5g97.why: The ceilings (massimali) are the compensation limits set by the contract or by law and do not rise automatically each year. What can change is the premium.

1sqob2f.q: The R.C.A. policy ceilings are returned to the customer at the end of the year if no accidents are caused.
1sqob2f.why: The ceiling (massimale) is the maximum the insurer will pay for damage you cause. It is not money paid in by the customer, so nothing is refunded.

1lkl166.q: In R.C.A. insurance, a contract with the "bonus malus" formula means the premium changes every year according to the number of accidents caused.
1lkl166.why: With bonus malus the premium goes down if you cause no accidents and up if you cause some, adjusted every year.

1h67pve.q: The "bonus malus" insurance formula does not apply to motorcycles.
1h67pve.why: The bonus malus formula also applies to motorcycles, like other vehicles subject to compulsory R.C.A. insurance.

1yn2jex.q: In R.C.A. insurance, a contract with the "bonus malus" formula is automatically cancelled if you cause more than two accidents.
1yn2jex.why: Causing accidents moves you to a worse class and raises the premium, but the contract is not cancelled automatically.

xfmqtf.q: In R.C.A. insurance, a contract with the "bonus malus" formula is set by a judge.
xfmqtf.why: A bonus malus contract is an agreement between the policyholder and the insurance company. A judge does not set it.

64b7nn.q: R.C.A. insurance is also valid for accidents occurring in European Union countries.
64b7nn.why: An Italian R.C.A. policy also gives cover in the other countries of the European Union.

xadzp4.q: R.C.A. insurance also covers criminal liability, depending on the premium paid.
xadzp4.why: R.C.A. covers only civil liability, meaning compensation for damage. Criminal liability is personal and cannot be insured.

1882dfv.q: R.C.A. insurance also covers the monetary administrative fines provided for by the Highway Code.
1882dfv.why: Administrative fines (sanzioni amministrative) must be paid by the offender and are not covered by R.C.A.

140zc8n.q: R.C.A. insurance covers any damage caused, even if it exceeds the set ceiling.
140zc8n.why: The insurer pays up to the agreed ceiling (massimale). Any excess amount must be paid by the person responsible.

jm2c7v.q: R.C.A. insurance covers only the driver's liability, not that of the vehicle's owner.
jm2c7v.why: R.C.A. covers the civil liability of the driver, the owner and others jointly liable for the vehicle's circulation.

9ukx4g.q: R.C.A. insurance covers only injury to people, because damage to property requires another type of contract.
9ukx4g.why: R.C.A. compensates third parties for both personal injury and property damage caused by the vehicle, within the ceiling.

1ayr9zg.q: After signing an R.C.A. insurance contract, the insurer must give the customer the insurance certificate.
1ayr9zg.why: When the contract is signed the insurer must issue the insurance certificate (certificato di assicurazione), which proves the cover.

1i8huze.q: R.C.A. insurance is compulsory by law.
1i8huze.why: Every motor vehicle must have third-party liability insurance in order to be used on the road. The law requires it.

1ir92jl.q: The compulsory insurance certificate must always be kept on board the vehicle.
1ir92jl.why: The compulsory insurance certificate must be kept in the vehicle and shown to the police on request.

lhte4l.q: After signing an R.C.A. insurance contract, the insurer must give the customer a list of affiliated body shops to contact in case of an accident.
lhte4l.why: The insurer must issue the insurance certificate. A list of affiliated body shops is not required.

1ophhze.q: After signing an R.C.A. insurance contract, the insurer must give the customer a booklet on first aid.
1ophhze.why: After signing, the insurer must hand over the insurance certificate. A first-aid booklet is not required.

bkc9zy.q: After signing an R.C.A. insurance contract, the insurer must give the customer a manual on how to avoid accidents.
bkc9zy.why: The insurer's obligation is to issue the insurance certificate. Handing over an accident-prevention manual is not required.

5etkws.q: Compulsory R.C.A. insurance includes compensation for damage caused by the vehicle, provided it is driven by the owner.
5etkws.why: R.C.A. compensates damage caused by the vehicle whoever is driving it, not only the owner.

1ro3v4.q: The driver must never overestimate his or her own driving ability.
1ro3v4.why: Overestimating yourself leads to taking excessive risks. A driver must know his or her limits and drive accordingly.

m47c7p.q: Traffic rules are established to ensure greater driving safety for all road users.
m47c7p.why: Traffic rules exist to make the road safer and more orderly for all road users.

159qxta.q: Concentrating on the satellite navigator's directions can be a source of distraction while driving.
159qxta.why: Looking at or focusing too much on the navigator takes your eyes and mind off the road.

15n6g8q.q: While driving, the driver must pay attention both to users ahead of the vehicle and to those at the roadside.
15n6g8q.why: The driver must watch the whole road scene, ahead and at the sides, because hazards can also come from the roadside.

1exurvp.q: Passengers making a racket in the vehicle can affect the driver's concentration.
1exurvp.why: Noise and commotion inside the vehicle distract the driver and reduce attention to the road.

1u2twzk.q: If you are not sure you can cross a junction safely, you must stop and wait until all vehicles with which there is a risk of collision have passed.
1u2twzk.why: When in doubt about crossing safely, stop and let pass any vehicles you could collide with.

23sjul.q: Talking heatedly with other people in the vehicle can negatively affect driving behaviour.
23sjul.why: A heated conversation distracts you and affects your mood, worsening attention and driving decisions.

z5pfzp.why: Attention while driving improves with practice and the habit of scanning the road systematically.

2qfz65.q: A driver must consider that he or she is not always able to assess his or her own driving abilities correctly.
2qfz65.why: People often misjudge their own abilities, especially when tired, emotional or under the influence. Caution is therefore needed.

1be524k.q: While driving, attention can also be affected by listening to very loud music.
1be524k.why: Very loud music distracts you and masks outside sounds such as horns and sirens, reducing hazard perception.

1giaer0.q: Anxiety can reduce the ability to pay attention to hazards.
1giaer0.why: Anxiety narrows your attention and makes it harder to notice hazards.

11ml8vg.q: Complying with the rules helps limit obstruction to traffic.
11ml8vg.why: When everyone follows the rules, traffic is more orderly and fluid and obstructions are avoided.

1caqbwa.q: Using a mobile phone while driving is dangerous because it reduces attention to the road.
1caqbwa.why: A phone takes your eyes, hands and mind off driving, greatly increasing the risk of an accident.

14c0ngb.q: Setting the satellite navigator while driving reduces attention to the road.
14c0ngb.why: Programming the navigator while moving takes your eyes and attention off the road. Do it while stationary.

y37gt5.q: Distraction while driving is one of the main causes of road accidents.
y37gt5.why: Distraction is among the leading causes of road accidents, together with speeding and failure to give way.

1x0o210.q: Attention while driving decreases when you are tired.
1x0o210.why: Tiredness slows reflexes and reduces concentration, increasing the risk of errors and micro-sleep.

5efhje.q: Using a mobile phone while driving, even with a hands-free kit, can reduce attention to the road.
5efhje.why: Even hands-free, a conversation occupies your mind and reduces attention, although your hands stay free.

1xdot97.q: To prevent accident risk, the driver must carefully assess the behaviour of other road users.
1xdot97.why: Watching and anticipating what others do lets you foresee hazards and avoid accidents.

yr26rq.q: While driving, the perception of a hazard and the driver's resulting reaction are influenced by environmental conditions.
yr26rq.why: Rain, fog, darkness and traffic change visibility and the driver's reaction time.

bwo392.q: It is dangerous while driving to take your eyes off the road, even for a few milliseconds.
bwo392.why: Even a fraction of a second without looking at the road can make you miss a sudden hazard.

ej65pm.q: Complying with traffic rules limits the risks of driving all vehicles, both motorised and non-motorised.
ej65pm.why: Traffic rules apply to all vehicles, including human-powered ones such as bicycles.

7bitsl.q: Becoming distracted while driving can cause road accidents that may have serious consequences.
7bitsl.why: Distraction can cause accidents, including serious ones, with injury and property damage.

l4rl7b.q: When crossing a junction you must maintain maximum concentration while driving.
l4rl7b.why: Junctions are conflict points between vehicles and pedestrians and demand maximum attention.

1mn7olk.q: Our senses cannot pick up all the stimuli present in the environment.
1mn7olk.why: Our senses have limited capacity and thresholds, so they do not pick up every stimulus in the environment.

evkdaz.why: Anger, anxiety and euphoria change what we pay attention to and reduce concentration while driving.

1i3dslz.q: Sometimes people expose themselves to situations riskier than they are able to handle.
1i3dslz.why: People can overestimate their abilities and take on risks greater than they can control.

p0r3jv.q: The driver may take his or her eyes off the road when he or she believes there is no imminent danger of an accident.
p0r3jv.why: The driver must never take his or her eyes off the road, because a hazard can appear suddenly.

1fim8db.q: Near a junction a driver may stop and, while waiting for other vehicles to pass, send a quick message with a mobile phone.
1fim8db.why: The driver must focus on the junction and must not use a phone to send messages. The ban also applies when stopped on the road.

1w219e6.q: The driver who intends to go first at a junction must approach it faster.
1w219e6.why: Right of way is set by rules and signs, not by speed. Speeding up to go first is dangerous and prohibited.

cg35p8.q: While driving, if the driver believes there is no imminent danger, he or she may dial a phone number on a mobile phone without stopping.
cg35p8.why: Dialling in motion is prohibited and dangerous whatever the perceived danger. You must stop in a permitted place.

sc776l.q: The behaviour of other road users is irrelevant to safe driving.
sc776l.why: To drive safely you must watch and anticipate the behaviour of other road users.

r3ihpa.q: The driver may disregard the behaviour of other road users if they do not follow the Highway Code.
r3ihpa.why: The driver must always take other road users into account, even if they break the rules, in order to avoid accidents.

1u8kbyz.q: While driving, the perception of a hazard and the driver's resulting reaction are not influenced by environmental conditions.
1u8kbyz.why: Environmental conditions such as rain, fog and darkness do affect the driver's perception and reaction.

1c6n235.q: A driver must always underestimate dangerous situations so as not to be overwhelmed by anxiety while driving.
1c6n235.why: Underestimating hazards is risky. You must assess them correctly and adapt your driving while staying calm.

12il2ed.q: The driver must accept passengers' requests to drive faster.
12il2ed.why: The driver is responsible for the driving and must respect speed limits and drive prudently, whatever passengers ask.

16anthx.q: The driver must concentrate mainly on the stretch of road no more than three metres in front of the vehicle.
16anthx.why: The driver must look far ahead and all around to anticipate hazards, not just right in front of the vehicle.

1apk4wl.q: While the vehicle is moving, the driver may program the navigator at any time.
1apk4wl.why: The navigator must be programmed while stationary. Operating it by hand in motion distracts you from driving.

z4v517.q: The rear-view mirror on the right side of the vehicle must be used only by experienced drivers.
z4v517.why: All drivers must use the mirrors, including the right-hand one, to check what is around the vehicle.

qjt6xe.q: Rear-view mirrors must be adjusted while the vehicle is moving.
qjt6xe.why: Mirrors must be adjusted before setting off, while stationary, so you are not distracted while driving.

ktffkw.q: Complying with traffic rules is important only if breaking them carries a high financial penalty.
ktffkw.why: The rules must always be followed because they protect everyone's safety, whatever the size of the fine.

tsn5lb.q: Complying with traffic rules is important for vulnerable users, but not for drivers of motor cars.
tsn5lb.why: The rules apply to all users, including car drivers, and protect everyone, especially vulnerable users.

1rrzis1.q: Complying with traffic rules is important when traffic is very heavy, but not when traffic is flowing freely.
1rrzis1.why: The rules must be followed at all times, in any traffic condition, including when traffic flows freely.

1u67t7f.q: The overtaking ban may be ignored if you have been queuing behind a slow vehicle for more than 10 minutes and believe you can overtake without danger.
1u67t7f.why: The overtaking ban must always be obeyed, regardless of how long you have been queuing or your own judgement.

1l9unka.q: Keeping to the correct position on the carriageway is a secondary rule that may, if appropriate, be disregarded.
1l9unka.why: Keeping the correct position on the carriageway is an essential safety rule and must always be followed.

omuq3l.q: Attention while driving is important only when carrying out dangerous manoeuvres such as overtaking.
omuq3l.why: Attention is needed throughout the whole journey, not only during dangerous manoeuvres.

1i5nt1x.q: Drinking a high-alcohol liquor improves attention after about 10 minutes.
1i5nt1x.why: Alcohol reduces attention, reflexes and risk perception and never improves driving.

triq6.q: Manually tuning the car radio does not cause loss of attention to the road, because it is a task you are used to doing.
triq6.why: Even habitual actions such as tuning the radio take your eyes and attention off the road.

y3xxp7.q: If you are in a state of mild intoxication, you can still drive safely.
y3xxp7.why: Even mild intoxication reduces reflexes and risk perception, so you cannot drive safely.

11ijk2c.q: The amount of attention you can give to the road while driving is unlimited.
11ijk2c.why: Attention is a limited resource. You can attend to only a certain number of stimuli at a time.

1k6zl90.q: With 0.5 grams per litre of alcohol in the blood you are able to concentrate better.
1k6zl90.why: Alcohol never improves concentration. Already at 0.5 g/l it reduces attention and reflexes, and the legal limit is exceeded.

9vpodd.q: Our senses are able to pick up all the stimuli present in the environment.
9vpodd.why: Our senses have limits and do not pick up every stimulus, so a hazard can go unnoticed.

1k7yeuw.q: Our senses are able to perceive stimuli of any intensity.
1k7yeuw.why: Our senses detect only stimuli above a certain intensity threshold. Stimuli that are too weak go unnoticed.

hlwlp3.q: In heavy traffic, stress can help the driver stay alert.
hlwlp3.why: Stress reduces concentration and clear thinking and leads to mistakes and aggressive behaviour.

2sg3r3.q: Hearing is not an important sense when driving.
2sg3r3.why: Hearing matters because it lets you detect horns, sirens and unusual vehicle noises, even outside your field of view.
